sources.name: Kaikki raw Wiktextract data for the Spanish Wiktionary edition
sources.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0 and GFDL-1.3-or-later; page-specific additional terms may apply
sources.attribution: Wikcionario contributors; Wikimedia; Wiktextract; Kaikki.org. No endorsement implied.
sources.transformation: pre-extracted raw Wiktextract JSONL; gzip-streamed into Elyndra's canonical pack schema
known_limitations: The edition contains multiple languages; only records with lang_code es and lang Español are imported.
The extraction error artifact is retained as evidence and never imported as lexical content.
Examples carrying an external ref are omitted because third-party licensing is ambiguous.
Named relation targets do not identify a stable target sense; Elyndra preserves only the source sense and target term.
